proposals.evidence: CDIAL 6261 *dādda is a nursery kin term expressly including elder brother in several languages. Simple dad-/dod- elder-brother forms fit; feminine dādī in this gloss, initial-vowel aḍḍa and dat- need local review. Reviewed comparison: bagheli_lakshman dadda “older brother” (f_y6ytmpk7rfw56). Possible intra-IA borrowing remains open under the user’s policy; exact source forms are retained.
